iva.title: VAT return
iva.subtitle: Period summary to reconcile form {form} in TRIBU-CR.
iva.draftNotice: This report is a reconciliation aid. The legal return is filed in TRIBU-CR, which prefills it from the documents Hacienda has already accepted.
iva.notFinalNotice: The period is not closed yet: {pending} documents are still being validated and {rejected} were rejected. Amounts may change.
iva.emptyBody: There are no issued or received documents for {period}.
iva.errorTitle: The report could not be generated
iva.errorBody: Something went wrong while loading the period. Try again in a few seconds.
iva.notRegisteredFiscalInfo: Complete the organization's fiscal information to generate the VAT return.
iva.notRegisteredCredentials: Set up the Hacienda credentials and certificate to generate the VAT return.
iva.section.salesHelp: Sales grouped by VAT rate rather than by economic activity — the shape the form has required since TRIBU-CR.
iva.section.purchasesHelp: Input VAT split by what each expense is used for: taxed activity, exempt activity, or mixed.
iva.section.proportionalityHelp: Prorrata percentage applied to mixed-use VAT. It is settled definitively in December.
iva.section.settlementHelp: Debit less credit, adjusted for prior balances, withholdings and offsets.
iva.deferredHelp: Credit sales with VAT deferred up to 90 days (sale condition 10). The tax is declared once collected.
iva.unacceptedPurchases: {n} purchase documents are still unaccepted. Their VAT is not creditable until you accept them.
iva.proportionalityNotApplicable: The organization only performs operations with full credit right, so no prorrata applies.
iva.warning.pending_hacienda_validation: {n} documents are still being validated by Hacienda and may be missing from the TRIBU-CR draft.
iva.warning.rejected_documents: {n} documents were rejected by Hacienda. Fix and reissue them before filing.
iva.warning.unaccepted_purchases: {n} purchase documents are unaccepted, so their VAT is not being credited.
iva.warning.missing_cabys: {n} lines have no CABYS code. Without CABYS the rate can land in the wrong row.
iva.warning.manual_orders_excluded: Manual orders are not electronic documents and stay out of the return.
iva.warning.provisional_proportionality: The applied prorrata is provisional. It is settled definitively in the December return.
